An arc apex is drawn at its genomic span in px, clamped to the band, so at this zoom every pair (concordant ~400bp upward) was clipped to the 40px ceiling and the band was one flat mass; at 200 the concordant domes resolve below the discordant pairs spanning the duplication. The two evidence callouts moved from raw viewport x/y to an anchor on the pileup track (fracY 0 + dy), so they now sit a fixed distance below the arc band whatever its height, per the rule in website/CLAUDE.md. FIXED in code (arcs/compute.ts): mate-link arc geometry used each mate's inward (gap) edge, understating a pair's radius by both mates' read lengths (~300bp) relative to the TLEN driving its color — a modest, unremarkable-looking arc could be painted long-insert red. desktop-ispcr-results.name: desktop-ispcr-results
desktop-ispcr-results.note: new: a real primer pair flanking TP53 exon 8 (the codon 273/282 hotspot), which is what you would order to Sanger-sequence the hotspot in a tumour. Products are drawn as read pairs, so the two primer footprints face inward across the 217bp they bracket with the amplicon as the connecting line, which is how a primer pair is drawn in every primer tool. The green tick near the forward primer's 5' end is a base that does not match the template: UCSC tolerates that and still reports the product, whereas the same substitution at the 3' end returns nothing (verified against the live server). The mock body is the response genome.ucsc.edu actually returned for this pair. Byte-identical across two runs at 1400x763.

pangenome/pggb_locus_graph.name: pangenome/pggb_locus_graph
pangenome/pggb_locus_graph.note: FIXED in the plugin (renderer/GeometryBuilder.ts, published as ae1aa4cabf9e and pinned in the three test_data/graphgenomeview configs). The reference-position ramp now paints an off-reference node a paler, softer version of the SAME hue as the reference it replaces (45%/72% against 70%/50%) instead of the identical swatch, so the Rank 1 row is no longer a copy of the Reference row. Rank went on lightness rather than on a second hue range, which would have had to mean position and rank at once and could state neither: hue is still position, which is the whole reason the scheme exists and the only thing a linear track can reproduce. referencePositionColor in specs/graph.ts carries the same branch off the feature rank field, so a lane opened on a contributing assembly cannot disagree with the graph beside it.

pangenome/rgfa_strain_launch.name: pangenome/rgfa_strain_launch
pangenome/rgfa_strain_launch.note: NEW. The third corner of the graph <-> linear <-> synteny trip, and the figure the launch fix made possible. K12 chr:2,056,000-2,064,000 is the asnW/asnU/asnV tRNA cluster, the sites E. coli pathogenicity islands integrate at; the graph gives CFT073 58,692 bp there in two segments while the other strains reach it through a few bp, so one long row is unambiguous. Launch view -> CFT073 opens chr:2,252,539-2,317,207 on CFT073 own coordinates, where its gene track names it clbA-clbS, the colibactin operon. Window chosen by scanning the segs/links BEDs: 8 kb is what keeps the launched locus at 65 kb, narrow enough for the clb genes to carry labels (a wider seed pulls in the yersiniabactin island and opens 130 kb of unlabelled boxes). Before the plugin fix this launch opened on No tracks active.
